_README: A small repo for quality/collectors/tests/tests.test.mjs, which writes these files into a temporary folder. Kept as JSON so no fixture .ts file is tracked where a type check or knip would read it.

files..github/workflows/site-tests.yml:
name: site-tests
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  changes:
    name: "site-tests: changes"
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - run: bash detect.sh
  tests:
    name: "site-tests: tests"
    needs: changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Type check, unit, Worker and the bot Worker tests
        run: npm run check:push
      - run: npm run test:dom
  site-tests:
    name: site-tests
    needs: [changes, tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - run: echo verdict
files..github/workflows/e2e.yml:
name: e2e
on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  changes:
    name: "e2e: changes"
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - run: bash detect.sh
  shard:
    name: "e2e: shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2"
    needs: changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2]
    steps:
      - run: npm run -w @cs/site e2e:install
      - run: npm run test:e2e -- --shard="$SHARD/2"
  e2e:
    name: e2e
    needs: [changes, shard]
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - run: echo verdict
